articles.summary: For seven days straight, we brought our entire 17-person team together for Tiptap's annual offsite on Spain's sunny southern coast, our favorite tradition of the year.
articles.title: Q2 '25 Hackathon and annual offsite in Málaga, Spain

articles.summary: That went quickly! After two months in beta, we’re announcing the release of the stable version of Tiptap 3.0. With over nine million downloads per month on npm, we hope this update will make many developers very happy.
articles.title: Tiptap 3.0 is stable

articles.title: A Notion-style editor, ready to use in Tiptap Cloud
